content.text: [Discord #mod-ops sam Tue Oct 14 10:00 PST 2025] OPERATIONS NOTICE (supersedes update_1 for TikTok cases): After review, TikTok appeal cases T-001 through T-007 that were approved in update_1 must be RESET to 'pending' status. The policy version used to evaluate these cases is under verification. This ONLY affects TikTok cases T-001 to T-007. YouTube cases (Y-001 to Y-006), Meta cases (M-001 to M-005), and Reddit cases (R-001 to R-002) from update_1 are NOT affected — keep their statuses. Also attaching TikTok Q3 2025 transparency report to replace the Q1 2025 data.

Understood. Operations notice applied: - TikTok cases T-001 to T-007: status reset to 'pending' (SUPERSEDES update_1 approval). - YouTube Y-001 to Y-006: status unchanged (approved). - Meta M-001 to M-003: status unchanged (approved); M-004 to M-005: unchanged (denied). - Reddit R-001 to R-002: status unchanged (pending). TikTok Q3 2025 report received and will replace the Q1 2025 data file.
